articles.title: Lucknow-Delhi Tejas Express becomes India's first privately branded train, to be called 'Sprite' Tejas
articles.summary: The Lucknow-Delhi Tejas Express has achieved a significant milestone, becoming India's first privately branded train. This innovative move in the railway sector sees the train now known as 'Sprite' Tejas, marking a new era for public-private partnerships in transportation. This development highlights evolving operational models within India's extensive railway network and could set a precedent for future collaborations in critical infrastructure.

articles.title: 80th Independence Day: PM Modi pays tribute to Mahatma Gandhi at Rajghat
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi commemorated India's 80th Independence Day by paying floral tributes to Mahatma Gandhi at Rajghat in New Delhi. On this significant national occasion, PM Modi also extended his greetings to the entire nation, remembering the sacrifices that led to India's freedom. This highlights the importance of national leaders honoring foundational figures.
